Name: More Coffee
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[b][color=#f1c232][size=5][font=Courier New][i]UPDATE on 10/30/2026[/i][/font][/size][/color]
[size=4][font=Courier New]Shared ingredients and supplies have moved to [color=#ffd966]Yuzu More Ingredients[/color], and the Antique Roaster has moved to [color=#ffd966]Yuzu More Craftables[/color].
Please install both mods and their requirements when updating. More Coffee contains the drinks and their recipes. You don’t need to install the other More food mods.
[color=#ff7700]Remove the old More Coffee folder before installing the updated version to avoid leaving outdated files behind.[/color][/font][/size][/b]




[b][i][color=#ea9999][size=5][font=Courier New]Antique Roaster[/font][/size][/color][/i][/b]
[b][size=4][font=Courier New]First, craft the roaster from the crafting menu. [/font][/size][/b]
[size=4][font=Courier New][b]Place five coffee beans inside to make one bag of Roasted Coffee Beans.[/b][/font][/size]


[color=#ea9999][size=5][font=Courier New][b][i]Secret Woods Spring Water[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color]
[b][size=4][font=Courier New]First, craft an Empty Springwater Bottle. You can find it under “Other” in the crafting menu.[/font][/size][/b]
[b][size=4][font=Courier New]Hold the empty bottle and go to the Secret Woods. You can collect water from any pond or river within the Secret Woods.[/font][/size][/b]
[size=4][font=Courier New][b]One empty bottle gives you five bottles of Secret Woods Spring Water.[/b][/font][/size]




[font=Courier New][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/color]
[/b][/font]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Download and unzip the file.[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Place the extracted folder directly into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Courier New][b]Keep the folder structure as it is.[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Courier New][b][color=#ff0000]Do not move or extract the individual mod folders from their parent folder.[/color]
[/b][/font][/size]

Downloads.Description:
REMOVE the old folder first.

DO NOT just overwrite when it update.

Version 8.0.0 is completely different from previous versions.
